scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @yaft/web & npm run start:dev --workspace @yaft/api
scripts.dev:local: docker compose up -d postgres && npm run dev
scripts.pm2:start: docker compose up -d postgres && npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.pm2:stop: npx pm2 stop ecosystem.config.js && npx pm2 delete ecosystem.config.js
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @yaft/api && npm run build --workspace @yaft/web
